text: Parlay update 03:22: the first parlay settled in our favor (a buyer's parlay missed): +$9.55, so realized is now -$16.68 (was -$26.23), 1 win and 5 losses; 13 are still open ($46 collateral) and wallet cash is back to $72.68. Small sample, but that's the first real win. The other session is working on pricing live (in-play) games, which is the biggest chunk we skip.
